instruction.text: Which image shows a risk of electrocution?

atoms.b: Any ((++electrical non-electrical)) appliance or socket is capable of causing electrocution.
((++Electrocution Drowning)) occurs when an electrical current travels through the body.

atoms.a: Aiesha would like to get some toast out of the toaster. She is going to use a metal knife. Is that safe?
Why is it dangerous to put metal into an electrical appliance or plug socket?
b: ++Metal conducts electricity, so if you put something made of metal into an electrical appliance, it will carry the electrical current to your body.
You might drop the electrical appliance, causing it to shoot electricity.

instruction.text: Decide whether the following act is safe or unsafe.

atoms.a: Putting your fingers into a plug socket or an electrical appliance.

atoms.b: It is dangerous to put your fingers into an electrical appliance because you could get ((++electrocuted wet)).

instruction.text: Decide whether the following act is safe or unsafe.

atoms.a: Unplugging a plug by holding the plastic part and avoiding touching the metal prongs.
Pulling a plug out by its cord.

feedback.end: It is dangerous to use damaged wires as it can lead to electric shocks.

atoms.b: It’s a bad idea to pull a plug out by its cord because you could ((++damage strengthen)) the wire.
